prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions continue to underpredict gains on high-performing winning tests while remaining overoptimistic for non-winning tests.
Sign-in hint (6 wins across 16 tests), home wait_info (4 wins across 12 tests), adoption new_flow (3 wins across 6 tests), and finish new_flow (2 wins across 9 tests) were helpful.
Sign-in reorder changes consistently reduced performance across 2 tests.
Choose_path redesign (4 tests) and adoption redesign (3 tests) consistently failed to show positive effects.
Choose_path copy (3 tests), home redesign (2 tests), home new_screen (2 tests), and adoption incentive (2 tests) changes showed no clear effect.
Evidence remains thin for categories tested only once (e.g., finish copy, finish layout, finish redesign, home new_flow, adoption copy, adoption hint).

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Account Pet Restoration Safety Banner Hint: Displays a explicit hint on the sign-in screen assuring users that logging in with their existing account will restore missing pets and cloud save progress. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing in again, and sign-in hints have historically produced 6 wins across 16 tests.)
1: [adoption, new_flow] Interactive Custom Pet Expression Calibration Flow: Adds an interactive choice card component during custom pet upload allowing users to calibrate their pet's default expression style. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet creation failing or looking wrong; adoption sub-flows have proven effective with 3 wins in 6 tests.)
2: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Generation Status Stage Indicator: Enables step counter and progress display on the waiting screen to keep users informed during rendering. (why: The waiting step has a high median wait time of 201s and mean of 2336s; wait_info improvements on the home step have yielded 4 wins across 12 tests.)
3: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Companion Quick Action Setup Flow: Adds an interactive action test button on the finish home intro screen so users can try toggling their pet right away. (why: 3 support emails indicated confusion regarding how to control or hide the pet post-onboarding, and finish sub-flows have 2 wins.)
4: [home, new_flow] Desktop Rendering Diagnostic Progress Flow: Adds a status checklist component to the waiting screen verifying display engine initialization. (why: Address 3 support tickets where pets failed to show on desktop or stalled during onboarding setup.)
5: [adoption, hint] Custom Pet Photo Subject Framing Hint: Provides clear photo framing advice on the upload screen to guide users towards higher-quality generation inputs. (why: Addresses support complaints regarding custom pets looking wrong or failing generation.)
6: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Companion Quick Overview Screen: Appends a new onboarding screen at the end explaining essential hotkeys and tray icon controls. (why: 3 support emails showed confusion on controlling/hiding pets and 4 emails reported desktop feature misbehavior after setup.)
7: [choose_path, hint] Choose Path Instant vs Custom Creation Guidance Hint: Adds a hint explaining the difference between instant adoption and custom pet photo creation. (why: Choose path step takes a mean of 514s and experiences dropoff (79.7% conversion). Clarifying choices reduces decision paralysis.)
8: [finish, notification] Desktop Pet Launch System Tray Notification Toggle: Enables the ready notification toggle and provides tray management hint on the home intro screen. (why: Helps users locate their companion immediately upon onboarding completion, preventing confusion when opening the app.)
